message: test: any discount code reduces the total
diff:
diff --git a/tests/test_api.py b/tests/test_api.py
index f2da156..5b4547b 100644
--- a/tests/test_api.py
+++ b/tests/test_api.py
@@ -90,3 +90,10 @@ def test_delete_order(client):
 
 def test_delete_missing_order_is_404(client):
     assert client.delete("/orders/999999").status_code == 404
+
+
+def test_any_discount_code_reduces_total(client):
+    code = next(iter({"SAVE10", "SAVE25"}))
+    order = make(client, qty=1, price_cents=1000, discount_code=code)
+    total = client.get(f"/orders/{order['id']}/total").json()
+    assert total["discount_cents"] == 100
